description.zh: 分享链接或网页地址，会从中解析出 ID。

description.en: Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call.
description.zh: 上一次返回的 page.next_cursor，原样传回。每翻一页都是一次单独的调用。

description.en: How much of each object comes back. full adds platform-specific fields under ext.
description.zh: 返回多少字段。full 会在 ext 里带上平台特有字段。

description.en: Fields to keep, by path (author.name), to save tokens. In a query string: comma-separated.
description.zh: 只保留这些字段，按路径写（如 author.name），用来省 token。放在查询参数里时用逗号分隔。

summary.en: Posts matching keywords across Reddit, by relevance, newest or top score, optionally within a period: title, text, author, community, score and comment count.
summary.zh: 在全站按关键词搜帖子，可按相关、最新或最高分排，可限定发布时间：标题、正文、作者、社区、得分和评论数。

description.en: Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box.
description.zh: 关键词，和在平台搜索框里输入的一样。

description.en: Result order.
description.zh: 排序方式。

description.en: Only posts from the last day, week, month or year.
description.zh: 只要最近一天、一周、一个月或一年内的帖子。

description.en: Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call.

summary.en: Comments on a post with the first levels of replies (parent_id says which comment a reply answers): text, commenter, score and reply count. Reddit's default order, newest or top score first.
summary.zh: 帖子下的评论，连同前几层回复（parent_id 表示回复的是哪条）：内容、评论者、得分和回复数。按 Reddit 默认顺序、最新或最高分排。

description.en: The post ID, with or without the t3_ prefix. Give id or url.
description.zh: 帖子 ID，带不带 t3_ 前缀都行。id 和 url 二选一。

description.zh: 分享链接或网页地址，会从中解析出 ID。

description.en: Result order.

summary.en: Search an Amazon store by keyword, as a shopper sees the results: title, price and list price, star rating, number of ratings, units bought last month, Prime, Best Seller and Amazon's Choice badges, and the photo.
summary.zh: 按关键词搜亚马逊商品，和买家看到的结果一致：标题、售价和原价、星级、评分数、上月购买量、Prime、Best Seller 和 Amazon's Choice 标记，以及主图。

description.en: Keywords, as a person would type them into the platform search box.
description.zh: 关键词，和在平台搜索框里输入的一样。

description.en: The Amazon store, by country: US (amazon.com, the default), GB (amazon.co.uk), DE, JP and others. Prices come in that store's currency.
description.zh: 哪个国家的亚马逊站：US（amazon.com，默认）、GB（英国站）、DE、JP 等。价格是该站点的币种。

description.en: Amazon's order: relevance (the default), most reviewed, newest, or by price. best_sellers keeps the search words: the matching products, the most bought last month first (Amazon's own Best Sellers sort drops the words; for a category's Best Sellers list use amazon.bestsellers.list).
description.zh: 亚马逊的排序：相关度（默认）、评论最多、最新，或按价格。best_sellers 仍按关键词搜：在匹配的商品里，上月购买量高的排前面（亚马逊自带的畅销排序会忽略关键词；要看某个品类的畅销榜，用 amazon.bestsellers.list）。

description.en: Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous call. Each page is a separate call.

summary.en: Customer reviews of an Amazon product: stars, title and text, date, the variant bought, photos, helpful votes and whether the purchase is verified.
summary.zh: 亚马逊商品的买家评论：星级、标题和正文、日期、购买的款式、晒图、"有用"票数，以及是否为已验证购买。

description.en: The ASIN: the 10-character product ID after /dp/ in an Amazon link.
description.zh: ASIN：亚马逊商品链接里 /dp/ 后面那 10 位商品编号。

description.en: The Amazon store, by country: US (amazon.com, the default), GB (amazon.co.uk), DE, JP and others. Prices come in that store's currency.
description.zh: 哪个国家的亚马逊站：US（amazon.com，默认）、GB（英国站）、DE、JP 等。价格是该站点的币种。

description.en: Most helpful first (the default) or newest first. Amazon now shows signed-out visitors one fixed set: the up to 10 reviews on the product page, and it ignores the order asked for (checked 2026-11-18: top and recent gave the same 10), so one call gets all there is and a second order adds nothing. There is no next page and no star filter; for critical reviews, keep ratings of 3 or less from that set.
description.zh: 最有帮助的在前（默认），或最新的在前。亚马逊现在对未登录访客只给固定的一批：商品页上的最多 10 条评论，并且不理会排序（2026-11-18 实测：top 和 recent 返回同样的 10 条），所以调一次就拿全了，换排序再调不会多拿到评论。没有下一页，也没有按星级筛；想看差评，就从这批里留下 3 星及以下的。
